title: Implement a schedule-expression language (firings, roll/offset/overflow, canonical form, exact errors) from SPEC.md
prompt:
Implement the `firetime` package in the current directory: a parser and evaluator for the schedule-expression language described in SPEC.md (for example `every 2nd tue of month at 09:30 except 2026-12-25`). SPEC.md is the contract, rule by rule: the Python API (`firetime.parse`, `firetime.next_fires`, `firetime.fires_between`, `firetime.canonical`, `firetime.ScheduleError`), the meaning of every construct and how they combine, the exact error messages and which one wins, the canonical form, and the command line (`python3 -m firetime next "<expr>" --after 2026-01-01T00:00 -n 5`, `python3 -m firetime between ...`, `python3 -m firetime canonical "<expr>"`). The package under firetime/ only has stubs so far; you may organise its code as you like.

tests/test_firetime.py has some examples (run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` from this directory); more tests than these check every rule of SPEC.md. Do not modify SPEC.md or tests/test_firetime.py. Code must run on /usr/bin/python3 (Python 3.9), the interpreter the checks use; standard library only.
